name: Hiyoshi Tomonari
source:
The protagonist's friend who gives off a light impression and only has eyes for cute girls.
The class mood maker because of his bright and positive personality.
He's has an undesirable relationship with Sakiko and their fights are a class special.
Nickname 'The Lightning Striker of Shion Hall'
